<b>The Marrow</b> is an [[Areas (Silksong)|area]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. Its now-crumbling roads are built upon the bones of ancient bugs long gone. 

== Description ==
The Marrow is located deep in the lowlands of [[Pharloom]]. Composed entirely of bone and the ancient shells of long-dead bugs, the Marrow forms the fragile foundation upon which the rest of the kingdom is built. The area is inhabited by [[Skull Scuttlers]], which use the old skulls as protection. The Marrow is also home to [[Flintbeetle]]s, explosive creatures that hold [[Flintgem]]s required for the <i>[[Volatile Flintbeetles]]</i> wish.

[[File:Screenshot SS The Marrow 05.png|thumb|left|200px|A typical room in the Marrow, featuring red flowers that Hornet can [[Needle-bounce]] off]]
Being one of the first areas [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] travels through, the Marrow is important on her journey. The [[Bell Beast]] is encountered here stuck in [[Silk]], and can be fought after binding the [[Silkspear]] in [[Bone Bottom]]. Defeating and taming the Bell Beast allows Hornet to unlock a useful [[Fast Travel (Silksong)|fast travel]] system.

Hornet can find a few useful tools, such as the [[Straight Pin]], and meet new NPCs for the first time, such as [[Sherma]] and [[Shakra]].

To the east is the entrance to [[Hunter's March]], guarded by a [[Skarrgard]], an early-game mini-boss. A nearby prison cell contains [[Grindle]], who Hornet can choose to free. Following the defeat of [[Widow]], [[Loddie]] takes up residence in the area, offering a pin-throwing minigame in exchange for several rewards. 

== History ==
[[File:Screenshot SS The Marrow 03.png|thumb|right|200px|An ancient skull found in the Marrow]]
Not much is known about the ancient past of [[Pharloom]], but it is evident that the Marrow is made almost entirely out of the shells and bones of ancient bugs. Fossilisation, similar to what is found in the [[Forgotten Crossroads]] in [[Hallownest]], over generations formed into the solid foundations of the land.<ref>[[Shakra]]: <i>"Crumbling roads built upon the shells of ancient bugs. All of Pharloom rests upon these fragile foundations."</i></ref><ref>[[Hollow Knight: Wanderer's Journal|Wanderer's Journal]], p. 19.</ref>

Similar skeletal structures can be found all over the lowlands of Pharloom, from [[Bone Bottom]] to the [[Far Fields]], suggesting that the land was inhabited by massive creatures in the past.<ref>[[:File:Screenshot SS Far Fields 10.png|Screenshot]] of the [[Skull Cave]].</ref><ref>[[:File:Screenshot SS Far Fields 19.png|Screenshot]] of remains in the Far Fields.</ref><ref>[[:File:Screenshot SS Far Fields 20.png|Screenshot]] of [[Frontier]] entrance.</ref>

Following the construction of [[the Citadel]], intricate roads and [[Bellshrine]]s were built through the land to make it easier for [[pilgrims]] to travel. Many pilgrims start their journey in the Marrow, and have to ascend through the kingdom as part of their holy [[Citadel#Pilgrimage|pilgrimage]].

== How to Access ==
The Marrow can initially be entered by going east of [[Bone Bottom]], which marks the edge of the [[Mosslands]].

== Special Rooms ==
=== Survivor's Camp ===
After the start of [[Act 3]], the survivors of [[Bone Bottom]] move to the central room where the [[Flea Caravan]] used to be and set up the Survivor's Camp. If the <i>[[Volatile Flintbeetles]]</i> wish is not completed by Act 3, the [[Memory Locket]] it rewards is instead found here.

The <i>[[Survivor's Camp Supplies]]</i> [[Delivery Wishes|delivery wish]] can be delivered here to [[Flick the Fixer]].

== Creation and Development ==
[[File:Early Screenshot 01.jpg|thumb|220px|Forest of Bones in <i>Hollow Knight</i>]]
The Marrow is one of the earliest <i>Silksong</i> areas to be worked on; in the August 2017 map, the first known in-game development map, it is the main area that is comparatively the most complete.<ref>[[Cut Content (Silksong)#Gallery|Early <i>Silksong</i> development maps]]</ref> Throughout development, it remained generally the same, with only a few notable changes, the most notable being that the Skarr were planned to invade the Marrow at some point in the game, according to an unused save profile flag.<ref name="skarrinvade"><code>hunterInfestationBoneForest</code></ref> The [[Cut Content (Silksong)/NPCs|Learned Pilgrim]] NPC, cut late into development, would have also appeared in the Marrow.

The Marrow is based on the cut <i>[[Hollow Knight]]</i> area, [[Cut Content (Hollow Knight)#Areas|Forest of Bones]]. Internally, it is often called <code>Boneforest</code>.<ref name="skarrinvade" /> [[William Pellen]] has stated that the idea of <i>Silksong</i> starting in a fiery area was an idea from the beginning, <i>"partly because [they] had started [working on the Forest of Bones] for Hollow Knight"</i>, which he called <i>"a nice environment"</i>.<ref name="bloomberg">[https://www.bloomberg.com/news/newsletters/2025-11-28/the-makers-of-hollow-knight-silksong-aren-t-done-just-yet The Makers of 'Silksong' Aren't Done Just Yet] ([[:File: Reference Boneforest.png|Archive]])</ref>

The area was showcased in the February 2019 <i>Silksong</i> reveal trailer,<ref>[https://youtu.be/pFAknD_9U7c?t=28 Hollow Knight: Silksong Reveal Trailer] (0:28)</ref> and it was the location used for the game's key art released alongside the announcement. In a June 2019 blog post, a screenshot of Shakra's room in the Marrow was shown, with its minor differences implying that she may have been skippable, as her platform could have been fully walked under.<ref>[https://www.teamcherry.com.au/blog/post-e3-wrap-silksong-systems-update Team Cherry blog post] of June 25th, 2019</ref> Footage of the Marrow Skull Tyrant's battle was included in the June 2022 <i>Xbox Game Pass Reveal Trailer</i>, showcasing him in a differently shaped arena.<ref name="xbox">[https://youtu.be/JSfuFlhsxZY?t=64 Hollow Knight: Silksong - Xbox Game Pass Reveal Trailer - Xbox & Bethesda Games Showcase 2022] (1:04)</ref>
